name: qwen3_5_9b_working_set_gap_quick_8m
description: Short throughput proof workload for medium KV capacity: a few durable project/user working sets fit in cache, while repeated one-off RAG churn makes plain LRU evict useful prefixes. This intentionally leaves realistic optimization room without using an unrealistically tiny KV cache.

scenario.global_unit: Stable enterprise assistant policy with tool rules, response schema, audit tags, permission boundaries, escalation logic, tenant routing hints, and long lived operational constraints.
scenario.tenant_unit: Tenant catalog metadata, integration names, data retention rules, field aliases, pricing groups, compliance tags, and formatting preferences remain stable across requests.
scenario.family_unit: Reusable workflow definitions, shared business rules, previous decision criteria, field normalization rules, approval thresholds, and repeated tool-call patterns define this family.
scenario.sticky_unit: Conversation history preserves prior user intent, assistant decisions, extracted fields, unresolved actions, tool observations, and follow-up constraints from earlier turns.
scenario.cold_unit: Unique evidence paragraph with one-off ticket notes, retrieval snippets, timestamps, numeric fields, customer details, attachments, and context that should not be reused later.
scenario.transient_unit: Temporary campaign template with near-duplicate labels, short lived field names, partial overlap, and suffix evidence that expires after a few requests.
scenario.decode_unit: Content generation brief with objectives, audience, tone, risk notes, examples, and constraints for a longer answer that stresses decode time rather than reusable prefill.
